title: A Fool's Prize
description: A mod that adds things revolving around foolishness, including assassin like items.
body:
This is a mod that contains an armor set, two tools, and a few items.
1. Follied Cutlass
   - Has a right click ability that freezes the **player** you are looking at within a 15 block reach (ONLY WORKS ON PLAYERS)
2. Follied Halberd
   - A multitool that has extended reach
3. Fool's Robes
   - An armor set that gives a passive speed boost and hides your locator bar waypoint.
4. Items
   - Tattered Cloth, obtainable by killing strays.
   - Follied Ingot, obtainable by combining Copper, Netherite, and Gold ingots in a smithing table.
   - Tattered Handle, obtainable by combing tattered cloth and sticks.
